articles.title: Sierra Doubles Valuation to $30B With $1.75B Series F as Enterprise AI Agent Demand Surges
articles.snippet: Sierra Doubles Valuation to $30B With $1.75B Series F as Enterprise AI Agent Demand Surges AI Insider
articles.text:
Business & Markets
Sierra Doubles Valuation to $30B With $1.75B Series F as Enterprise AI Agent Demand Surges
By James Dargan · 27 November 2026 · 1 min read
Sierra , the enterprise customer experience company co-founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor, has secured $1.75 billion in a Series F round that doubles its valuation to $30 billion. The deal comes less than six months after a previous round valued it at $15 billion .
Greenoaks and Lightspeed Venture Partners led the round, joined by existing investors including Benchmark, Sequoia, GV and Tiger Global.
Sierra said it serves nearly half of Fortune 50 companies, including BNY, HSBC, Wells Fargo and JPMorganChase, and that its outcome-based pricing helped double run-rate revenue to $400 million in five months . The company is building a platform for creating agents and developing agent protocol definitions with Meta, Stripe and Walmart. The new capital will fund further agent development and expanded sales teams.
Customer experience AI startups are commanding soaring valuations, with ElevenLabs at $22 billion, Wonderful at $5 billion and Decagon at $4.5 billion.
Co-founder Clay Bavor has argued that most Sierra customers are reassigning contact center staff rather than replacing them.

articles.snippet: [Acer Gaming FY2026 Q3 Earnings Call] Q3 Revenue Hits NT$1.264 Billion, a Record for the Period; GTA VI Launches With $3.79 Billion, Management Calls 2027 "Quite Optimistic" finance.biggo.com
articles.text:
[Acer Gaming FY2026 Q3 Earnings Call] Q3 Revenue Hits NT$1.264 Billion, a Record for the Period; GTA VI Launches With $3.79 Billion, Management Calls 2027 "Quite Optimistic"
Add preferred source
Acer Gaming (6908.TW) reported consolidated revenue of NT$1.264 billion (approximately $38.4 million) for the third quarter of 2026, up 5.6% quarter over quarter and marking the highest third-quarter figure since the company's founding. September revenue came in at NT$497 million (approximately $15.1 million), up 12.5% year over year, and climbed further to NT$550 million (approximately $16.7 million) in October, a 10.4% monthly gain. On the earnings call, management characterized 2027 as "quite optimistic," driven chiefly by GTA VI — an annual blockbuster for which Acer Gaming holds exclusive PlayStation distribution rights — which generated $3.79 billion in revenue on its first day, more than four times the $800 million posted by predecessor GTA V at launch, with a long-tail effect expected to last a full year. A dense slate of PS5 exclusives in 2027 adds to the outlook, with Acer Gaming as the exclusive seller in Taiwan. Its game-art outsourcing subsidiary Winking Studios has formally entered Europe and North America following its acquisition of Canada's Ampera Studios, with indicative bookings of $51.6 million over the next 24 months. Consolidated operating income is currently negative; management attributed this to non-cash transitional expenses from restricted stock units (RSUs) used to retain talent at the overseas acquisition, stressing that the distribution business itself is healthy and that results will return to a growth trajectory once the acquisition's benefits materialize.

September revenue came in at NT$497 million (approximately $15.1 million), up 12.5% year over year; October revenue climbed further to NT$550 million (approximately $16.7 million), a 10.4% monthly increase, signaling that channel-stocking momentum ahead of GTA VI's launch is already underway.
"GTA has already set the highest record in the history of entertainment — $3.79 billion in revenue on its first day on the market," Acer Gaming management said in opening the earnings call, framing what this year's blockbuster means for the company's distribution business. Flatiron Energy Closes $850M for Chelsea Battery
Flatiron Energy has closed on $850 million in commitments for the 1,200-MWh Energizar battery storage project in Chelsea, Massachusetts.
Updated on Nov. 27, 2026 in Energy
Flatiron Energy closed $850 million in construction and financing commitments for the 1,200-MWh Energizar battery project in Chelsea, Massachusetts, expected to be the East Coast's largest battery system. AI Illustration. Upload story photo >
Live Poll

▲ Yes ▼ No
Flatiron Energy closed on $850 million of construction and financing commitments for the Energizar Project, a 1,200-MWh battery energy storage system. The project will be built in Chelsea, Massachusetts, and is expected to be the largest battery system on the East Coast.
Why it matters
Energizar is designed to provide grid stability, capacity and peaking energy to the Boston area during high-demand periods. The project reflects rapid growth in battery storage, with US capacity at 17 GW at the end of last year.
Energizar's maximum power capacity is 250 megawatts with 1,200 MWh of storage, while the related Trimount facility will hold 2,800 MWh. Whether the Energizar timeline holds through commercial operation in the fourth quarter of 2027 has not been confirmed.
The players
Flatiron Energy
Flatiron Energy is the company that closed the $850 million in construction and financing commitments for the Energizar Project.
The details
Flatiron Energy closed on the commitments to support the Energizar Project in Chelsea, Massachusetts. A separate Trimount Energy Storage Facility in the Boston area is expected to be completed in 2028-2029 with a 2,800 MWh capacity.
Timeline
End of last year (2025): US storage capacity reached 17 GW.
Fourth quarter 2027: Energizar expected to reach commercial operation.
2028-2029: Trimount Energy Storage Facility expected to be completed.
2030: US storage capacity projected to reach 31 GW.
Roadmap
Energizar is one of the projects driving US storage capacity from 17 GW toward a projected 31 GW by 2030. Its scale fits a broader global expansion in battery storage, which is growing 45% year-over-year.
Storage projects like Energizar are designed to keep the grid stable during peak demand, which can support reliability for households and businesses in the Boston area. The project's commercial start date is set for late 2027.
The takeaway
Large battery projects such as Energizar show how storage is becoming a core part of grid planning, not just a supplement to generation. Watch for the 2027 commercial start to see whether the schedule holds.
What happens next
Energizar is expected to reach commercial operation in the fourth quarter of 2027, and the Trimount Energy Storage Facility is expected to be completed in 2028-2029.

articles.title: AI Funding: Ottawa Boosts Its Fund by $700 Million
articles.snippet: AI Funding: Ottawa Boosts Its Fund by $700 Million Brief IA
articles.text:
Business & Startups · Tom Levy · November 26, 2026
AI Funding: Ottawa Boosts Its Fund by $700 Million
Key Takeaways
1 Canada adds 700 million Canadian dollars to its AI computing fund, reaching 1 billion.
2 Increased support is planned for companies using infrastructure owned and operated in Canada.
3 The first new call focuses on health and life sciences.
Why it matters : the initiative aims to direct computing demand towards local providers.
Canada is contributing an additional 700 million Canadian dollars to its AI Computing Access Fund. Its total now reaches 1 billion Canadian dollars.
Ottawa Promises 500 Megawatts of Capacity
Ottawa plans to deploy its own AI-dedicated computing capacity, amounting to 500 megawatts. The announced credits for the fund stem from the Canadian national AI strategy presented in June.
In October, the government also supported the raising of 7 billion dollars by Cohere. The country is also attracting interest from foreign companies: OpenAI claims it has the necessary energy resources and land for establishing data centers.
Increased Support for Computing in Canada
The new phase allocates higher support to companies using computing infrastructures owned and operated in Canada. This enhancement aims to generate demand from local providers. According to Evan Solomon, Canada's Minister of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Innovation, "Canadian ideas need Canadian computing power."

Key points
Uni-Fuels Holdings (NASDAQ:UFG) increased its fiscal 2026 revenue outlook to US$410 million–US$430 million from US$340 million–US$360 million.
Gross profit increased 128% to US$7.5 million, while gross margin expanded to 2.4% from 1.7%.

Uni-Fuels Holdings ( NASDAQ:UFG ) raised its fiscal 2026 revenue guidance after reporting strong growth in revenue and profitability during the first nine months of the year, supported by business expansion and its outlook for the fourth quarter.
The marine fuel supplier now expects full-year revenue of between US$410 million and US$430 million, compared with its previous forecast of US$340 million to US$360 million.
For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, revenue increased 62% year over year to US$307.8 million.
Gross profit rose 128% to US$7.5 million, while gross margin improved to 2.4% from 1.7% in the corresponding period last year.
Uni-Fuels reported net income of US$1.5 million, reversing a net loss of approximately US$30,000 a year earlier.
Operating income increased 1,293% to US$2.1 million, while EBITDA climbed 622% to US$2.6 million.
The company's operating margin, measured against gross profit rather than revenue, increased to 28.7% from 4.7%.

articles.text:
News

/ FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem (FFR) Announces parent company Faraday Future (FFAI) Ownership of Approximately $41 Million in FFR Equity
FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem (FFR) Announces parent company Faraday Future (FFAI) Ownership of Approximately $41 Million in FFR Equity
4 min read
FFR FFAI
Reinforcing Long-Term Commitment to the Growth of FFR and filed a Schedule 14C with the Securities and Exchange Commission
LOS ANGELES, Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc. ( FFR ) ("FFR" or the "Company"), a U.S.-based Embodied AI ("EAI") robotics company, today announced it had filed a preliminary Schedule 14C with the Securities and Exchange Commission, which includes pro forma financial information for the acquired robotics business, as well as additional disclosures related to FFR's acquisition of the robotics business of Faraday Future ( FFAI ), including transaction details, ownership structure, and other relevant information for stockholders and investors, marking the completion of all material matters required of both parties post deal closing.
As of November 25, 2026, FFAI beneficially owned approximately 14.7 million shares of FFR common stock, representing approximately 53% of FFR's 27.7 million shares currently outstanding. Following the issuance of shares contemplated by FFR's acquisition of the robotics business, FFAI is expected to own approximately 80.1 million shares, or approximately 75% of FFR's anticipated 106.2 million outstanding shares. All newly issued FFR shares received by FFAI in the transaction are subject to an 18‑month lock-up period. Based on FFR's closing market price on November 25, 2026, the implied value of FFAI's expected ownership position would be approximately $41 million.
The holding reflects Faraday Future's continued commitment to supporting the development of the FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem and aligns FFAI's interests with those of FFR stockholders as the company advances the commercialization of its robotics, AI, and intelligent automation solutions.
"FFAI's substantial ownership position reflects its continuing strategic alignment with FFR," said YT Jia, Global CEO of FFAI and FFR. "We believe FFR is uniquely positioned at the intersection of artificial intelligence and robotics, with a growing portfolio of technologies, products, strategic partnerships, and commercialization initiatives designed to create long-term shareholder value."
FFR has continued to expand its robotics ecosystem through advancements across its key business pillars, including Physical AI Devices, the Physical AI Brain and Developer Platform, Industry Productivity Solutions, and the Physical AI Data Factory. The company has also been pursuing commercialization opportunities across enterprise, education, service, and industrial applications.
FFR's strategy is supported by several key factors:
Expanding market demand for intelligent robotics and AI-enabled automation solutions;
Continued development of FFR's integrated robotics ecosystem;
Growth in strategic partnerships and commercial deployments;
Increasing opportunities to monetize robotics solutions in K-12 education sector, security and surveillance among others; and
The potential for long-term value creation as the robotics industry continues to mature globally.
FFAI will continue to evaluate opportunities to further support FFR's strategic initiatives, subject to market conditions, corporate requirements, and applicable regulations.
